channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-vba
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: ZipArchive — via awesome-vba
item.description: A single-class pure VB6 library for zip with ASM speed. Compatible with 32-bit VBA and Twinbasic.

item.title: VBE_Colours — via awesome-vba
item.description: A small external utility to configure the colours of the VBE editor. Not open-source, but its Github presence provides additional information.

item.title: The VBA Help — via awesome-vba
item.description: A site dedicated to VBA with a large number of instructive blog posts. Written by the author of VBE_Extras, an AddIn for the VBA IDE and VBE_Colours, a small utility to configure the available colors used by the VBA IDE.

item.title: SHA256 — via awesome-vba
item.description: A repository of cryptographic primitives implemented in VBx and compatible with VB6, both 32- and 64-bit VBA and TwinBasic.

item.title: MS Access VCS Addin — via awesome-vba
item.description: Synchronize Access Forms, Macros, Modules, Queries, Reports, and more with a version control system for MS Access.
